box.highlights: Northport 41, Centereach 7: Simon Blissett had 265 yards of offense and four touchdowns to lead visiting Northport in Suffolk II. Luke Loiacono scored on a nine-yard run and a 31-yard pass from Blissett. Daniel Miller had three receptions for 70 yards and a touchdown. Greyson Cabrera added 73 yards and a score for the Tigers.

Northport 55, Half Hollow Hills East 21: Simon Blissett found Carson Ciaio for a 76-yard touchdown through the air, kickstarting Northport's win at Half Hollow Hills East in Suffolk II. Greyson Cabrera followed with a 28-yard interception return for a score and later added a 55-yard pick six, as well as a 53-yard receiving touchdown from Blissett. Blissett finished with 245 passing yards and four touchdowns, throwing 34 and 51-yard scores to Daniel Miller. Tommy Zarcone scored on a 65-yard fumble recovery for the Tigers (2-0). Daniel White scored a three-yard rushing touchdown for Half Hollow Hills East (0-2).

Northport 21, Connetquot 13: Greyson Cabrera had a 35-yard rushing touchdown and a 38-yard receiving score to lead host Northport (3-0) in Suffolk II. Cabrera had 135 yards of offense and made 16 tackles. Ryder Maag took a screen pass 71 yards for a score in the third quarter. Carson Ciaio batted down the final pass as time expired as Northport stopped Connetquot four times from inside the 10-yard line in the final minute. Vincent Feraca had a rushing touchdown for Connetquot (1-2).

Northport 33, Deer Park 6: Simon Blissett threw for 335 yards and rushed for 71 with three touchdowns passing and one rushing to lead host Northport (4-0) in Suffolk II. Danny Miller contributed two touchdowns and three sacks. Tommy Zarcone added 11 tackles including three for loss.

Northport 21, Newfield 7: Luke Loiacono blocked a 1st quarter field goal attempt and returned it 52 yards and then scored a 3-yard TD to lead visiting Northport (5-0) in Suffolk II. Loiacono also caught a 25-yard pass from Simon Blissett. Carson Ciaio closed the scoring on a 4-yard pass from Blissett. Dante Powell scored a rushing TD for Newfield (2-3).
Northport defeats Huntington in Suffolk II to earn its first 6-0 start since 2009.

Northport 42, West Babylon 0: Simon Blissett completed 5 of 5 passes for 152 yards and 3 TDs and added a 51-yard rushing TD to lead host Northport (7-0) in Suffolk II. Greyson Cabrera had 2 TD receptions and a sack on defense.

East Islip 31, Northport 21: Jake Simmons rushed for 242 on 35 carries and 3TDs to lead visiting East Islip (7-1) in Suffolk II. Niko Meyers rushed for 37 yards on 4 carries and 1 TD and Chris Coreas had an 18-yard FG. Simon Blissett completed 13 of 24 passes for 287 yards and 2 TDs for Northport (7-1).

Northport 28, Bellport 21: Greyson Cabrera had 3 TDs and an interception to lead host Northport (8-1) in Suffolk II. Simon Blissett completed 13 of 20 passes for 253 yards and Tommy Zarcone and Tristen Magro each had 8 tackles. Shawn Aliperti added 7 tackles and a sack. Cameron Casher had 2 TD runs for Bellport (5-4), including a 60-yard run.

No. 1 East Islip defeats No. 4 Northport in the Suffolk Division IV semifinals. East Islip (9-1) will face the winner of No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East/No. 3 Huntington in the final at 6 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 22 at Stony Brook University.
